title: The 8 Best Miter Saw with Slide 2026
h1: The 8 Best Miter Saw with Slide 2026
metaDescription: Our 8 picks for miter saw with slide 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at miter saw with slide 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: DEWALT DWS779 12-Inch Sliding Compound Miter Saw
products.blurb: Key specs: 14-inch crosscut capacity, Tall fence for nested crown molding, Cam-lock miter detent.
strengths: 14-inch crosscut is the widest in the 12-inch class, handles the widest crown molding
Cam-lock detent system locks accurately and releases quickly
Tall fence supports crown upright for nested cuts without a jig
Industry-standard reliability, most common professional saw in North America
limitations: Rails extend behind the saw, requires 12+ inches of wall clearance
features: Tall fence for nested crown molding
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: Bosch GCM12SD Axial-Glide Miter Saw
products.blurb: Key specs: Axial-glide mechanism, no rear rail extension, 3-inch wall clearance required, 15-amp motor.
strengths: Axial-glide eliminates the rear rail extension, fits against a wall in a tight shop
Electronic speed control keeps blade at constant RPM under load
Smooth glide action, easier to produce clean, consistent pull-through cuts
Dual bevel with stainless steel detent plate, accurate and durable
limitations: Complex mechanism is more expensive to service than standard rail slides
features: Axial-glide mechanism, no rear rail extension

products.name: Makita LS1019L 10-Inch Dual-Bevel Sliding Saw
products.blurb: Key specs: 10-inch blade with 13.5-inch crosscut capacity, Built-in laser guide, Dual bevel.
strengths: Built-in laser is the most useful and accurate integrated laser
Direct-drive motor is quieter and maintenance-free compared to belt-drive
Dual bevel with positive stops at common angles, accurate without adjustment
Lighter than 12-inch saws, easier to set up and move
limitations: 10-inch blade limits crosscut to 13.5 inches vs 14+ for 12-inch saws
Higher price than DEWALT at similar capacity

products.name: Metabo HPT C12RSH2 12-Inch Sliding Saw
products.blurb: Key specs: 15.5-amp motor, Compact sliding design, Laser guide.
strengths: 15.5-amp motor, highest amperage in the sliding saw category
Compact rear rail design reduces wall clearance requirement vs standard rail slides
Laser guide improves cut alignment without marking every board
Lower price than DEWALT and Bosch at comparable specifications
limitations: Metabo HPT service centers fewer than DEWALT in some regions
Compact rail limits maximum slide travel slightly

products.name: SKIL MS6305-00 10-Inch Dual-Bevel Sliding Miter Saw
products.blurb: Key specs: 15-amp motor, 10-inch blade with sliding rails, Dual bevel.
strengths: Dual bevel and true sliding rails at the lowest price on this list
15-amp motor handles standard woodworking materials
Laser guide helps beginners align cuts
Lower price point, accessible for hobbyist use
limitations: 10-inch blade limits crosscut capacity versus 12-inch saws
Fence less rigid than professional alternatives
products.bestFor: value-focused buyers who want the most for their money

products.name: Bosch CM10GD 10-Inch Dual-Bevel Glide Miter Saw
products.blurb: Key specs: 10-inch blade with axial-glide mechanism, Crosscut capacity: 12 inches, Dual bevel.
strengths: Dual bevel at a price well below most sliding 10-inch saws
Axial-glide design needs minimal rear clearance, fits against a wall
12-inch crosscut capacity handles standard wide lumber and most molding
Bosch build quality and accuracy at a budget-sliding price point
limitations: Fewer accessories included than the larger GCM12SD
10-inch blade limits maximum crosscut versus 12-inch saws
features: Compact footprint, no rear rail protrusion
products.bestFor: value-focused buyers who want the most for their money

products.name: Festool Kapex KS 120 REB Miter Saw
products.blurb: Key specs: Compact sliding mechanism, Integrated dust extraction, Electronic speed control.
strengths: Dust extraction integration captures the majority of chips, cleanest cutting environment
Electronic control maintains constant blade speed regardless of material density
Lightest 12-inch sliding saw on the market by a significant margin
Festool accuracy: angles verified correct at the factory, minimal setup
limitations: The highest price on this list by a large margin
Festool ecosystem, dust extraction designed for proprietary extractor
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: WEN MM1015 10-Inch Dual-Bevel Sliding Miter Saw
products.blurb: Key specs: 10-inch sliding with dual bevel, LED cutline indicator, Crosscut capacity: 12 inches.
strengths: Dual bevel at a price near the budget single-bevel alternatives
LED cutline indicator projects a shadow-free reference line for alignment
12-inch crosscut capacity handles most standard applications
WEN 2-year warranty with accessible customer service
limitations: Rail slide action has more play than premium alternatives
Motor handles standard materials but slows noticeably in dense hardwood

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
